Given that $M$ is the midpoint of $\overset{―}{AB}$, what is the value of $x?$
question.worked_solution:
Since $M$ is the midpoint of $\overset{―}{AB}$, the segment $\overset{―}{AB}$ is twice the length of the segment $\overset{―}{AM}.$ So, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}2AM & =AB \\ 2(2x+1) & =5x-2 \\ 4x+2 & =5x-2\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we subtract $4x$ from both sides of the equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}4x+2-4x & =5x-2-4x \\ 2 & =x-2\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we add $2$ to both sides:

$$
\begin{aligned}2+2 & =x-2+2 \\ 4 & =x \\ x & =4\end{aligned}
$$
